anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The deploy script refuses the target `production` without the confirm flag.
- [ ] The migration script converts legacy status to reviewed status.
- [ ] The script rejects an order with a missing, blank or unknown status.
- [ ] Already reviewed orders remain unchanged.

## Integration
- Archive the cutover log.
- Notify the support desk.
- The operator runs the cutover.
- The change merges only after the vendor confirms the fix.
- The staging queue is empty before the deploy.
- After the cutover, no production order carries the legacy status.
- After deploy to staging, login succeeds against the real identity provider.
- The operator runs the migration script on live orders.

## Proposed Reporter note
```text
Reporter note: original Acceptance Criteria rows moved to Integration or rewritten during repair (verbatim):
- [ ] The operator runs the cutover.
- [ ] The change merges only after the vendor confirms the fix.
- [ ] The staging queue is empty before the deploy.
- [ ] After the cutover, no production order carries the legacy status.
- [ ] After deploy to staging, login succeeds against the real identity provider.
- [ ] The migration script converts legacy status to reviewed status, and the operator runs it on live orders.
```

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved four facts from fails to holds and lost none. Sorting by the shared definition moved all five externally fulfilled rows (operator cutover, vendor confirmation, empty staging queue, production-order status, deployed login) out of Acceptance Criteria into Integration as separate source-worded items, where Before left vendor confirmation and a truncated login row under Acceptance Criteria and dropped the staging-queue row from the body entirely. The verbatim-retention rule made the Reporter note quote all five originals plus the whole mixed migration row, where Before quoted only two of the five and prefixed them with a 'retired workflow-stage proof' label. Carrying housekeeping under Integration replaced the old Post-deployment housekeeping heading while keeping both Archive the cutover log and Notify the support desk. Keeping scenarios of the same constraint together left missing, blank and unknown status as one rejection criterion instead of Before's three. The `production` deploy row and `Already reviewed orders remain unchanged.` stayed as written in both. To keep this stable, keep the wording that names environment-defining literals and same-constraint scenarios as staying under Acceptance Criteria, and keep the explicit instruction that a mixed row splits with its file-delivered clause in Acceptance Criteria, its external clause in Integration and the whole original in the note. One thing to watch: the split-off Integration entry 'The operator runs the migration script on live orders.' is a rewording rather than source wording; that is fine for the mixed fact as written, but if you want source-worded entries throughout, say how a split clause should be phrased.
